tests.name: Editing message text reflects in list and state
Add text message button appends and selects
Add voice message adds microphone bubble
Duplicate message copies message right below
Delete message removes it from the list
Appearance settings update preview frame and stage
Paste Import dialog opens, parses, and cancels with ESC
Export dialog opens with tabs and duration info
Edge Case: Delete all messages displays friendly empty state
Edge Case: Extremely long text and emojis in message
